steps.text: 1. The Tourist opens the details of a priced public tour. A1.
2. The system shows the price, a preview of the first place and the "Buy tour" button.

exceptions.text: E1. Not signed in → "You need to sign in to buy a tour." and a "Sign in" button (UC#01); the API returns 401.

steps.text: 4. The system shows the "Confirm tour purchase" dialog (tour name, price, payment through VNPay).
6. The system (Payment) checks the tour, price and purchase eligibility; creates a pending order (expires in 15 minutes) and returns a signed VNPay URL. E2, E3, E4.

exceptions.text: E2. The tour is no longer public → 404 "The tour is no longer available"; the price has changed → 409 "The tour price has changed, please check again".
E3. This tour is already bought → 409 "You have already bought this tour"; a pending order exists → its URL is returned again.
E4. The Tourist is the author → 403 "You do not need to buy your own tour".

steps.text: 7. The client sends the Tourist to the VNPay page.
8. The Tourist pays on the VNPay page. A2, E5.

exceptions.text: E5. Payment fails (card declined, insufficient balance, wrong OTP) → the order is failed, "Payment unsuccessful" with a "Try again" button.

steps.text: 9. VNPay calls the IPN; the system checks the signature, order code and amount, marks the order paid and publishes payment.completed; Tour records the access. E6, E7.

exceptions.text: E6. Wrong signature → RspCode 97, the order is not changed; wrong amount → RspCode 04, the order is failed; unknown order code → RspCode 01.
E7. IPN resent for an order already paid → RspCode 02, no access is granted and no email is sent again.

steps.text: 10. The result page shows "Payment successful. You can now listen to this tour." and a "Start listening" button. E8.

exceptions.text: E8. No IPN yet → "Confirming payment…", asks again every 3 seconds for 1 minute; on timeout → "No confirmation received yet. The result will appear in Notifications."

steps.text: 11. Notification stores an in-app notification and sends a receipt email.

steps: A1. The tour is already bought, or the Tourist is the author / Admin: shows "Purchased" and the "Start listening" button, as for a free tour.
A2.1. The Tourist cancels the transaction on VNPay.
A2.2. The order moves to cancelled; the result page shows "You cancelled the payment." and a "Try again" button.
